subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork fix for this schema mismatch, or close that candidate and allow a new narrow repair?
rationale: The bug and fix shape are clear, but the active candidate is conflicting, non-maintainer-editable, and bundled with unrelated stale changes, so automation should not create a competing repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt a narrow replacement
options.body: Create or sponsor a maintainer-editable repair that preserves credit for the fork work, keeps only the schema fix, and drops unrelated daemon/systemd changes.

options.title: Ask the fork author to narrow and rebase
options.body: Keep waiting on the open fork PR, but this leaves the issue blocked on an external branch maintainers cannot edit directly.

options.title: Close the candidate then queue repair
options.body: Close the conflicting fork candidate first, then let a new single-purpose fix PR handle the schema mismatch.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Create or sponsor a maintainer-editable repair that preserves credit for the fork work, keeps only the schema fix, and drops unrelated daemon/systemd changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The documented config behavior traces to this owner history, and the decision is about the correct config/schema repair path.
